title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
abstract: arXiv:2611.23127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. translated_title: 接地的幻觉：视觉-语言模型是否像理想观察者那样权衡检索到的文本与图像？
translated_abstract: 检索增强的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）从两种可能各自失效的证据来源中生成答案：检索到的文本可能是错误的或含噪声的，图像也可能退化或与文本相矛盾。我们提出了GIB-200K——一个基于COCO和Visual Genome构建、包含200,000个图像-问题条目的基准数据集，每个条目都被扩展为受控的压力测试条件：硬负例检索噪声（1-20个文档）、视觉歧义（高斯模糊与运动模糊、低资源裁剪）以及带有反事实翻转对的跨模态冲突。我们不仅测量性能退化，还探究模型如何组合这两种模态。基于理想贝叶斯线索组合理论，我们推导出可检验的预测，从而给出“知识惯性”（相对于模型自身的图像证据，文本被过度加权）与“感官捕获”（相反情形）的形式化定义，并通过经测量误差校正的回归来估计权重，同时验证了该方法对已知权重的恢复能力。反事实翻转分解……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了包含20万个条目的GIB-200K压力测试基准，并从理想贝叶斯线索组合理论出发，首次形式化定义并量化了视觉-语言模型在融合检索文本与图像证据时的“知识惯性”与“感官捕获”偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GIB-200K, a 200,000-item stress-test benchmark, and derives from ideal Bayesian cue combination the formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia and Sensory Capture to quantify how vision-language models mis-weight retrieved text versus image evidence.
